literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 基因组分析确定了 H3L 等蛋白质中的关键突变,这些突变促进了宿主特异性适应性和免疫逃避。 [10.1177/15303667261469046]
该 LSR 将综合人群中 MPOX 疫苗的证据,特别关注孕妇、儿童和青少年。 [10.1186/s13643-026-03254-2]
此外,我们观察到,相对于中央保守区,进化枝 IIb 基因组可变区中每千碱基的 APOBEC3 相关 SNP 显着更高(P<0.001)。 [10.64898/2026.07.15.26357894]
我们的计算表明,E8L 中的单个 N18D 突变(其中 D8 中的 N18 对应于 E8L 中的 D18)引入了与抗体残基 D34 L 的静电排斥,引发局部构象变化,将关键残基 R20 从 W106 H 和 Y33 L 形成的芳香笼中取代。 [10.1039/d6cp02084d]

PMA-qPCR 可区分传染性病毒和非传染性病毒。皮肤病变和肛门拭子中的传染性 MPXV 载量最高,是咽喉拭子的 100 多倍。在表面样本中,41.54% (140/337) 通过 qPCR 检测出 MPXV DNA 呈阳性,但其中只有 25.71% (36/140) 含有低载量 (126.79 ± 93.57 PFU/mL) 的传染性病毒。对于废水,来自患者生活环境的家庭样本的 qPCR 检测呈阳性,11.32%(6/53),但未检测到传染性 MPXV。在来自航班或污水处理厂的 498 个航站废水样本中未检测到 MPXV DNA。 [10.1186/s41182-026-01028-z]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.lead_en: This literature brief prioritizes publications in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency and source convergence.
key_findings_en: Genomic analyses identify key mutations in proteins like H3L that facilitate host-specific adaptability and immune evasion. [10.1177/15303667261469046]
This LSR will synthesize evidence on mpox vaccines across populations, with particular focus on pregnant persons, children, and adolescents. [10.1186/s13643-026-03254-2]

Further, we observed significantly higher APOBEC3-associated SNPs per kilobase (P<0.001) in clade IIb genomic variable regions relative to their central conserved region. [10.64898/2026.07.15.26357894]

Our calculations revealed that the single N18D mutation in E8L (where N18 in D8 corresponds to D18 in E8L) introduces electrostatic repulsion with antibody residue D34 L , triggering local conformational changes that displace key residue R20 from the aromatic cage formed by W106 H and Y33 L . [10.1039/d6cp02084d]

PMA-qPCR discriminated infectious from non-infectious virus. Infectious MPXV loads were highest in skin lesions and anal swabs, exceeding throat swabs by more than 100-fold. [10.1186/s41182-026-01028-z]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.caveats_en: Some evidence is abstract-only, observational or derived from narrative reviews; conclusions should be interpreted in light of study design and evidence strength.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.

news.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期新闻资格由来源、日期、正文身份和相关性终审决定；中文翻译状态不影响有效新闻的保留。中文字段不可用时，本区域使用已核验英文内容填充。
key_findings_zh: 《感染与公共卫生杂志》上发表的一篇研究文章分析了 2024 年布隆迪布琼布拉的 MPOX 流行病学特征和传播动态。该研究是在三个指定治疗中心进行的一项前瞻性队列研究。 [news-05c01b93ba1cff26]
西澳卫生当局已就 Mpox 发出警告。这一情况已得到证实,今年的病例激增超过了 2025 年记录的病例总数。 [news-979a16fa5a1ef12a]
因奥谢·西布利死亡罪被判入狱 20 年 2026 年 7 月 19 日 0 德米特里·波波夫 (Dmitriy Popov),因 2023 年在布鲁克林加油站误杀同性恋舞者奥谢·西布利而被判入狱 20 年,将入狱 20 年。 [news-d7c2817f24f36e69]
《病毒学杂志》上发表的一项研究比较了 MPXV clade IIa 和 clade IIb 分离株在多种小鼠模型中的毒力。该研究是一项经过证实的科学研究。 [news-35084ab1303e6020]
Tonix Pharmaceuticals 宣布在《病毒学杂志》上发表一篇经过同行评审的论文,题为“猴痘病毒 clade IIb 分离株在多种小鼠模型中相对于 clade IIa 分离株表现出较低的毒力”。该研究引入了三种新的小鼠模型来研究 MPOX 发病机制。 [news-977cf03599a23c15]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.caveats_zh: 中文翻译不完整时会以英文证据填充中文显示位置，并在后台记录translation_status=english_fallback。
news.lead_en: News eligibility is determined by source, date, body identity and final relevance. Translation completeness does not determine whether an eligible report is retained.
key_findings_en: A research article published in the Journal of Infection and Public Health analyzing the epidemiological characteristics and transmission dynamics of mpox in Bujumbura, Burundi, during 2024. The study is a prospective cohort study conducted at three designated treatment centers. [news-05c01b93ba1cff26]

Health authorities in WA have issued a warning regarding Mpox. The situation is confirmed, with a spike in cases this year exceeding the total number of cases recorded in 2025. [news-979a16fa5a1ef12a]

Teen found guilty of O’Shae Sibley death to spend 20 years in jail 19 July 2026 0 Dmitriy Popov, the man found guilty of the manslaughter of gay dancer O'Shae Sibley at a Brooklyn petrol station in 2023 will spend 20 years behind bars. [news-d7c2817f24f36e69]

A research study published in the Journal of Virology comparing the virulence of MPXV clade IIa and clade IIb isolates in multiple murine models. The study is a confirmed scientific investigation. [news-35084ab1303e6020]

Tonix Pharmaceuticals announced the publication of a peer-reviewed paper in the Journal of Virology titled 'Monkeypox virus clade IIb isolate exhibits reduced virulence relative to clade IIa isolates in multiple murine models.' The study introduces three new mouse models to investigate mpox pathogenesis. [news-977cf03599a23c15]

papers.title: The Evolving Landscape of Monkeypox: From Endemic Pathogen to Global Threat
papers.abstract: Background: Monkeypox (mpox) is a reemerging viral zoonosis caused by the mpox virus (MPXV) that has significant global public health implications following the 2022 and 2024 outbreaks. This review examines the evolving landscape of MPXV, focusing on its genomic organization, epidemiological shifts, phylogenetic relationship with variola virus, zoonotic transmission cycles, and the critical interventions for therapeutic targets and vaccine development. Methods: A comprehensive narrative review of literature from 2020 to 2026 was conducted. Key thematic insights were synthesized using Bibliometrix, Scopus Analytics, and VOSviewer to analyze global trends in transmission dynamics, clinical manifestations, and therapeutic interventions. Results: The review highlights the divergence of MPXV into Clades I and II, noting that while Clade IIb drove the 2022 global outbreak, the more virulent Clade Ib has dominated the 2024 reemergence. Zoonotic spillover remains a primary risk through contact with reservoirs such as rope squirrels and Gambian pouch rats, although human-to-human transmission has evolved to include rapid community spread among specific high-risk populations. Genomic analyses identify key mutations in proteins like H3L that facilitate host-specific adaptability and immune evasion. Current clinical management relies on supportive care, with targeted use of the JYNNEOS vaccine and antivirals like tecovirimat for severe cases. Conclusions: The continued reemergence of mpox underscores the necessity for an integrated “One Health” approach to surveillance and pandemic preparedness. Future research must prioritize environmental wildlife monitoring, genomic surveillance of emerging clades, and the development of multi-epitope vaccines to effectively mitigate both zoonotic spillover and human transmission.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘 (mpox) 是一种由 mpox 病毒 (MPXV) 引起的重新出现的病毒性人畜共患病,在 2022 年和 2024 年爆发后对全球公共卫生产生了重大影响。本综述探讨了 MPXV 的演变情况,重点关注其基因组组织、流行病学变化、与天花病毒的系统发育关系、人畜共患传播周期以及治疗靶点和疫苗开发的关键干预措施。方法:对 2020 年至 2026 年的文献进行全面的叙述性回顾。使用 Bibliometrix、Scopus Analytics 和 VOSviewer 综合关键主题见解,分析传播动态、临床表现和治疗干预的全球趋势。结果:审查强调了 MPXV 分化为分支 I 和 II,并指出虽然分支 IIb 推动了 2022 年的全球疫情爆发,但毒性更强的分支 Ib 主导了 2024 年的重新爆发。尽管人与人之间的传播已经发展到包括在特定高危人群中快速社区传播,但通过接触绳松鼠和冈比亚袋鼠等宿主,人畜共患病的溢出仍然是主要风险。基因组分析确定了 H3L 等蛋白质中的关键突变,这些突变促进了宿主特异性适应性和免疫逃避。目前的临床管理依赖于支持性护理,针对严重病例有针对性地使用 JYNNEOS 疫苗和 tecovirat 等抗病毒药物。结论:mpox 的持续重新出现强调了采用综合“同一个健康”方法进行监测和大流行防范的必要性。未来的研究必须优先考虑环境野生动物监测、新兴进化枝的基因组监测以及多表位疫苗的开发,以有效减轻人畜共患病的溢出和人类传播。

papers.title: Safety, immunogenicity, efficacy, and effectiveness of mpox vaccines in pregnant persons, children, and adolescents: a protocol for a living systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox is a zoonotic disease caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV) that became a global health concern following the 2022 outbreak. It poses a significant threat to immunocompromised individuals, children, and pregnant persons. Disease spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and propagation to other countries has led to recent declarations of public health emergencies. Smallpox vaccination cessation has further heightened population vulnerability to MPXV. In response, MVA-BN and LC16m8, vaccinia-based vaccines originally developed for smallpox, have been repurposed for mpox, demonstrating promising safety and immunogenicity profiles. Despite these advancements, challenges remain in vaccine distribution and in understanding vaccine efficacy across populations, particularly in key at-risk groups. Available evidence remains fragmented and largely derived from adult populations, with limited data in pregnant persons, children, and adolescents. This living systematic review (LSR) aims to evaluate the safety, efficacy, effectiveness, and immunogenicity of mpox vaccines across populations, with particular focus on pregnant persons, children, and adolescents. METHODS: We aim to conduct a LSR and meta-analysis based on biweekly searches of medical databases and clinical trial registries from inception to the current date to systematically identify relevant studies of mpox vaccines across populations. Pairs of reviewers will independently select eligible studies, extract data, and assess the risk of bias. We will include randomized clinical trials, quasi-experimental studies, cohort studies, case-control studies, cross-sectional studies, and case reports. Primary outcomes will include safety, efficacy/effectiveness, and immunogenicity of mpox vaccines across populations, including outcomes in pregnant persons (with neonatal outcomes), children, and adolescents. Meta-analyses will be conducted, including prespecified subgroup and sensitivity analyses. We will use the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) approach to assess the certainty of evidence. DISCUSSION: This LSR will synthesize evidence on mpox vaccines across populations, with particular focus on pregnant persons, children, and adolescents. As mpox continues to pose a global threat, particularly in endemic and low-resource settings, timely and rigorous assessment of vaccine performance is essential to guide equitable immunization policies and maternal-child health strategies. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO): CRD42024554330 (pregnant persons) and CRD42024556977 (children and adolescents).

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:MPX 是一种由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 引起的人畜共患疾病,该病毒在 2022 年爆发后成为全球健康问题。它对免疫功能低下的个人、儿童和孕妇构成重大威胁。疾病在刚果民主共和国(DRC)蔓延并传播到其他国家,导致最近宣布进入公共卫生紧急状态。天花疫苗接种的停止进一步加剧了人群对 MPXV 的脆弱性。为此,最初为天花开发的基于牛痘的疫苗 MVA-BN 和 LC16m8 已被重新用于天花,显示出有前景的安全性和免疫原性。尽管取得了这些进展,但在疫苗分发和了解疫苗在人群中的功效方面仍然存在挑战,特别是在关键高危人群中。现有证据仍然支离破碎,并且主要来自成年人群,孕妇、儿童和青少年的数据有限。这项实时系统评价 (LSR) 旨在评估 MPOX 疫苗在不同人群中的安全性、有效性、有效性和免疫原性,特别关注孕妇、儿童和青少年。方法:我们的目标是根据从开始到目前每两周一次的医学数据库和临床试验注册检索来进行 LSR 和荟萃分析,以系统地识别跨人群的 MPOX 疫苗的相关研究。成对的评审员将独立选择符合条件的研究、提取数据并评估偏倚风险。我们将包括随机临床试验、准实验研究、队列研究、病例对照研究、横断面研究和病例报告。主要结局将包括 MPOX 疫苗在人群中的安全性、有效性/有效性和免疫原性,包括孕妇(包括新生儿结局)、儿童和青少年的结局。将进行荟萃分析,包括预先指定的亚组和敏感性分析。我们将使用建议评估、制定和评估分级 (GRADE) 方法来评估证据的确定性。讨论:本 LSR 将综合人群中mp​​ox 疫苗的证据,特别关注孕妇、儿童和青少年。由于MPOX继续构成全球威胁,特别是在流行和资源匮乏的环境中,及时、严格地评估疫苗性能对于指导公平的免疫政策和母婴健康战略至关重要。系统评价注册:国际系统评价前瞻性登记册 (PROSPERO):CRD42024554330(孕妇)和 CRD42024556977(儿童和青少年)。

papers.title: From clinical fluids to environmental matrices: quantitative monitoring of infectious monkeypox virus based on PMA-qPCR during the Guangdong outbreak
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Mpox, caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), remains a public health priority. Standard qPCR detects viral DNA but cannot distinguish infectious virions from residual genetic material of inactivated virus, complicating transmission risk assessment. This study aimed to develop a rapid assay for quantifying infectious MPXV across clinical and environmental matrices in Guangdong Province, China. Methods We developed a propidium monoazide-assisted qPCR (PMA-qPCR) assay that selectively amplifies DNA from intact virions, and embedded it within the Guangdong provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention surveillance network. We examined 23 clinical fluid specimens from 15 mpox patients, 337 surface swabs and 53 domestic wastewater samples from patient living environments, and 498 terminal wastewater samples from flights and sewage treatment plants collected between June 2023 and August 2024. Decay kinetics were evaluated at 25 °C and 30 °C under varying pH, with initial viral loads of 10 3 and 10 4 PFU/mL. Results PMA-qPCR discriminated infectious from non-infectious virus. Co-incubation with 50 μM PMA and 0.005% SDS effectively blocked amplification of non-infectious DNA, and the assay showed quantitative concordance with the standard plaque assay. Infectious MPXV loads were highest in skin lesions and anal swabs, exceeding throat swabs by more than 100-fold. Among surface samples, 41.54% (140/337) tested positive for MPXV DNA by qPCR, but only 25.71% (36/140) of these contained infectious virus at low loads (126.79 ± 93.57 PFU/mL). For wastewater, 11.32% (6/53) of domestic samples from patient living environments tested positive by qPCR, yet no infectious MPXV was detected. No MPXV DNA was detected in 498 terminal wastewater samples from flights or sewage treatment plants. Decay experiments demonstrated that when the initial concentration was 10 3 to 10 4 PFU/mL, infectious MPXV decreased by more than 99% within 48 h, with accelerated decay under acidic pH and elevated temperature, particularly at lower initial concentrations. Conclusions PMA-qPCR provides a practical tool for rapid cross-matrix quantification of infectious MPXV. Direct contact with skin lesions or anal secretions likely dominates transmission, whereas environmental persistence is limited. Testing for infectious virus within 48 h of collection is recommended, as infectious MPXV decays by over 99% within this window.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 引起的 Mpox 仍然是公共卫生的重点。本研究旨在开发一种快速检测方法,用于定量中国广东省临床和环境基质中的传染性 MPXV。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了2023年6月至2024年8月期间收集的15名mpox患者的23份临床液体样本、来自患者生活环境的337份表面拭子和53份生活废水样本,以及来自航班和污水处理厂的498份航站楼废水样本。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员开发了一种单叠氮化丙啶辅助 qPCR (PMA-qPCR) 检测方法,可选择性扩增完整病毒体的 DNA,并将其嵌入广东省疾病预防控制中心监测网络中。与 50 μM PMA 和 0.005% SDS 共孵育可有效阻止非感染性 DNA 的扩增,且检测结果与标准噬菌斑检测结果定量一致。
elements_zh.main_results: PMA-qPCR 可区分传染性病毒和非传染性病毒。皮肤病变和肛门拭子中的传染性 MPXV 载量最高,是咽喉拭子的 100 多倍。在表面样本中,41.54% (140/337) 通过 qPCR 检测出 MPXV DNA 呈阳性,但其中只有 25.71% (36/140) 含有低载量 (126.79 ± 93.57 PFU/mL) 的传染性病毒。对于废水,来自患者生活环境的家庭样本的 qPCR 检测呈阳性,11.32%(6/53),但未检测到传染性 MPXV。在来自航班或污水处理厂的 498 个航站废水样本中未检测到 MPXV DNA。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: PMA-qPCR 为传染性 MPXV 的快速跨基质定量提供了实用工具。直接接触皮肤病变或肛门分泌物可能是传播的主要途径,而环境持久性有限。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了检测临床样本是否具有传染性病毒的重要性以及 MPXV 的有限环境持久性,从而为监测策略提供了信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有与其他检测方法进行比较,也没有使用来自不同地理区域的更大样本量,这可能会限制研究结果的普遍性。由于具体背景和样本量,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Monkeypox: An integrated review of virology, epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccinology, and public health strategies
papers.abstract: Monkeypox (Mpox), caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), has shifted from an endemic zoonosis in Central and West Africa to a pathogen of global public health significance. Two World Health Organization (WHO) Public Health Emergencies of International Concern were declared and subsequently lifted. Clade Ib has continued to emerge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries, recombinant MPXV strains have been detected, and inequities in access to diagnostics, vaccines, and therapeutics persist. These factors need critical synthesis to inform clinical practice and public health preparedness. This paper reviewed MEDLINE, Embase, WHO situation reports, the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and Prevention surveillance bulletins, prioritizing peer-reviewed literature and official reports, with preprints identified where cited. MPXV comprises two major clades with distinct epidemiological, clinical, and virological profiles. Clade Ib shows apolipoprotein B mRNA editing enzyme catalytic subunit 3 consistent mutational signatures indicating sustained human adaptation, and has driven a large ongoing outbreak in Central and East Africa. Clade IIb drove the 2022 global outbreak, predominantly through sexual contact among men who have sex with men. Diagnosis relies on polymerase chain reaction of lesion specimens, with whole genome sequencing needed for subclade and recombinant characterization. Tecovirimat has shown no significant clinical benefit in randomized trials for clade I disease, leaving treatment guidance unresolved. JYNNEOS offers approximately 82% pre-exposure effectiveness against clade IIb, though direct clade Ib effectiveness data remain limited, and equitable access to countermeasures in high-burden African settings remains critically inadequate. Priorities include strengthened genomic surveillance in Africa, expanded access to JYNNEOS, and urgent clade Ib-specific effectiveness data.

papers.title: Nationwide Mpox Genomic Surveillance Reveals Clade Ib Introductions, APOBEC3-Driven Evolution, and Terminal Deletions
papers.abstract: Background: The 2022-2023 global mpox outbreak highlighted the critical need for robust genomic surveillance capabilities to track mpox virus (MPXV) evolution and transmission dynamics. Methods Building upon our established SARS-CoV-2 sequencing infrastructure, we implemented a Molecular Loop probe-based long-read sequencing approach using Pacific Biosciences Sequel II technology for comprehensive MPXV genomic surveillance across the United States (US). From August 2024 to June 2025, we generated 326 high-quality whole genome sequences from residual mpox-positive clinical specimens collected by Labcorp across all 10 US Department of Health and Human Services regions. Results Our analysis identified two samples containing clade Ib MPXV in January and June 2025 and captured shifting trends in clade IIb diversity, with 13 distinct lineages observed. We also identified multiple instances of large (~1.6-17.6kb) deletions proximal to the inverted terminal repeats in clade IIb genomes. APOBEC3 mutation analysis indicated substantial evidence of human-to-human transmission among both clades. Further, we observed significantly higher APOBEC3-associated SNPs per kilobase (P<0.001) in clade IIb genomic variable regions relative to their central conserved region. Our assay exhibited strong reproducibility across biological replicates from individual patients and accuracy was confirmed via parallel sequencing of select specimens by US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) using metagenomic sequencing. We also demonstrated via custom simulation that our assay discriminates all known MPXV clades and lineages, including those we have not observed in the US. Conclusions Our integrated nationwide surveillance system facilitates real-time genomic tracking of outbreak evolution, with demonstrated capacity across SARS-CoV-2 and MPXV, positioning this platform for rapid deployment during future pathogen emergence.

papers.title_zh: 全国 Mpox 基因组监测揭示了 Clade Ib 的引入、APOBEC3 驱动的进化和末端删除
papers.source_body_en: Background: The 2022-2023 global mpox outbreak highlighted the critical need for robust genomic surveillance capabilities to track mpox virus (MPXV) evolution and transmission dynamics. Methods Building upon our established SARS-CoV-2 sequencing infrastructure, we implemented a Molecular Loop probe-based long-read sequencing approach using Pacific Biosciences Sequel II technology for comprehensive MPXV genomic surveillance across the United States (US). From August 2024 to June 2025, we generated 326 high-quality whole genome sequences from residual mpox-positive clinical specimens collected by Labcorp across all 10 US Department of Health and Human Services regions. Results Our analysis identified two samples containing clade Ib MPXV in January and June 2025 and captured shifting trends in clade IIb diversity, with 13 distinct lineages observed. We also identified multiple instances of large (~1.6-17.6kb) deletions proximal to the inverted terminal repeats in clade IIb genomes. APOBEC3 mutation analysis indicated substantial evidence of human-to-human transmission among both clades. Further, we observed significantly higher APOBEC3-associated SNPs per kilobase (P<0.001) in clade IIb genomic variable regions relative to their central conserved region. Our assay exhibited strong reproducibility across biological replicates from individual patients and accuracy was confirmed via parallel sequencing of select specimens by US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) using metagenomic sequencing. We also demonstrated via custom simulation that our assay discriminates all known MPXV clades and lineages, including those we have not observed in the US. Conclusions Our integrated nationwide surveillance system facilitates real-time genomic tracking of outbreak evolution, with demonstrated capacity across SARS-CoV-2 and MPXV, positioning this platform for rapid deployment during future pathogen emergence.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:2022-2023 年全球 MPX 爆发凸显了对强大的基因组监测能力的迫切需求,以跟踪 MPXV 的进化和传播动态。方法 在我们已建立的 SARS-CoV-2 测序基础设施的基础上,我们使用 Pacific Biosciences Sequel II 技术实施了基于分子环探针的长读长测序方法,以在美国 (US) 进行全面的 MPXV 基因组监测。从 2024 年 8 月到 2025 年 6 月,我们从 Labcorp 在美国卫生与公众服务部所有 10 个地区收集的残留 MPOX 阳性临床标本中生成了 326 个高质量的全基因组序列。结果我们的分析在 2025 年 1 月和 6 月鉴定了两个含有进化枝 Ib MPXV 的样本,并捕获了进化枝 IIb 多样性的变化趋势,观察到了 13 个不同的谱系。我们还在进化枝 IIb 基因组中发现了多个靠近反向末端重复序列的大缺失(~1.6-17.6kb)实例。APOBEC3 突变分析表明两个分支之间存在人际传播的大量证据。此外,我们观察到,相对于中央保守区,进化枝 IIb 基因组可变区中每千碱基的 APOBEC3 相关 SNP 显着更高(P<0.001)。我们的检测在个体患者的生物重复中表现出很强的重现性,并且美国疾病控制和预防中心 (CDC) 使用宏基因组测序对选定样本进行并行测序,从而证实了准确性。我们还通过定制模拟证明,我们的检测可以区分所有已知的 MPXV 进化枝和谱系,包括我们在美国未观察到的那些。结论 我们的全国综合监测系统有利于对疫情演变进行实时基因组跟踪,并在 SARS-CoV-2 和 MPXV 方面展示了能力,使该平台能够在未来病原体出现期间快速部署。

papers.title: Computational rescue of antibody binding to monkeypox virus E8L: from electrostatic repulsion to salt bridge-enhanced affinity.
papers.abstract: The ongoing Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak underscores the need for effective therapeutic antibodies. Antibody VACV-66 binds strongly to the vaccinia virus D8 protein but shows markedly reduced cross-reactivity to the MPXV homolog E8L, despite >95% sequence identity. In this study, we combined AlphaFold3 modeling, molecular dynamics simulations, and ASGB-IE free energy calculations to investigate this mechanism and rationally design high-affinity antibody mutations targeting E8L. Our calculations revealed that the single N18D mutation in E8L (where N18 in D8 corresponds to D18 in E8L) introduces electrostatic repulsion with antibody residue D34 L , triggering local conformational changes that displace key residue R20 from the aromatic cage formed by W106 H and Y33 L . Based on this mechanism, saturation mutation of D34 L identified three optimal mutations (D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N) that enhance binding free energy by removing electrostatic repulsion, restoring R20 insertion into the aromatic cage, and forming new favorable interactions. Quantitative analysis of the binding free energy contributions of residues N18 and R20 across different systems provided additional support for this mechanism. This work elucidates how a single viral mutation dampens antibody cross-reactivity and provides a general computational strategy for mechanism-guided antibody optimization against emerging orthopoxviruses. The identified D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N mutants represent promising candidates for experimental validation and therapeutic development.

papers.title_zh: 抗体与猴痘病毒 E8L 结合的计算拯救:从静电排斥到盐桥增强亲和力。
papers.source_body_en: The ongoing Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak underscores the need for effective therapeutic antibodies. Antibody VACV-66 binds strongly to the vaccinia virus D8 protein but shows markedly reduced cross-reactivity to the MPXV homolog E8L, despite >95% sequence identity. In this study, we combined AlphaFold3 modeling, molecular dynamics simulations, and ASGB-IE free energy calculations to investigate this mechanism and rationally design high-affinity antibody mutations targeting E8L. Our calculations revealed that the single N18D mutation in E8L (where N18 in D8 corresponds to D18 in E8L) introduces electrostatic repulsion with antibody residue D34 L , triggering local conformational changes that displace key residue R20 from the aromatic cage formed by W106 H and Y33 L . Based on this mechanism, saturation mutation of D34 L identified three optimal mutations (D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N) that enhance binding free energy by removing electrostatic repulsion, restoring R20 insertion into the aromatic cage, and forming new favorable interactions. Quantitative analysis of the binding free energy contributions of residues N18 and R20 across different systems provided additional support for this mechanism. This work elucidates how a single viral mutation dampens antibody cross-reactivity and provides a general computational strategy for mechanism-guided antibody optimization against emerging orthopoxviruses. The identified D34 L R, D34 L K, and D34 L N mutants represent promising candidates for experimental validation and therapeutic development.
papers.abstract_zh: 正在进行的 Mpox(猴痘)爆发凸显了对有效治疗抗体的需求。抗体 VACV-66 与痘苗病毒 D8 蛋白强烈结合,但与 MPXV 同源物 E8L 的交叉反应性显着降低,尽管序列同一性 >95%。在本研究中,我们结合AlphaFold3建模、分子动力学模拟和ASGB-IE自由能计算来研究这一机制,并合理设计针对E8L的高亲和力抗体突变。我们的计算表明,E8L 中的单个 N18D 突变(其中 D8 中的 N18 对应于 E8L 中的 D18)引入了与抗体残基 D34 L 的静电排斥,引发局部构象变化,将关键残基 R20 从 W106 H 和 Y33 L 形成的芳香笼中取代。基于这一机制,D34 L 的饱和突变确定了三个最佳突变(D34 L R、D34 L K 和 D34 L N),它们通过消除静电排斥、恢复 R20 插入芳香笼并形成新的有利相互作用来增强结合自由能。对不同系统中残基 N18 和 R20 的结合自由能贡献的定量分析为该机制提供了额外的支持。这项工作阐明了单个病毒突变如何抑制抗体交叉反应性,并为针对新兴正痘病毒的机制引导抗体优化提供了通用计算策略。已鉴定的 D34 L R、D34 L K 和 D34 L N 突变体代表了实验验证和治疗开发的有希望的候选者。

papers.title: Mpox Virus Infection Epidemiology Pathogenesis and Prevention
papers.abstract: Introduction: Mpox (previously known as monkeypox) is a zoonotic viral disease caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV), an enveloped, double-stranded DNA virus in the genus Orthopoxvirus within the family Poxviridae. The virus was first isolated in 1958, but in recent years it has once again emerged as a major public health issue worldwide, with cases reported in more than 120 nations. Methods: This review critically examines what is currently known about the epidemiology, virology, and public health of Mpox; assesses how Mpox is transmitted; identifies vulnerable groups within the population; examines new and emerging strains of the virus; and reviews the methods currently available to prevent and treat Mpox. A comprehensive literature search was conducted by using databases such as PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. Results: Mpox is transmitted to humans from animals and from human-to-human contact, including close physical and sexual contact. The groups at highest risk are children, people with compromised immune systems, and pregnant women. The emergence of a new strain, Clade Ib, represents a potentially serious and/or fatal threat to people in Africa, and the development of vaccines (MVA-BN, LC16m8) and antiviral medications such as tecovirimat has been successful in controlling and preventing Mpox disease, but access to the vaccines and treatments varies widely throughout the world. Discussion: While significant progress has been made in developing vaccines and antiviral treatments for Mpox, containment of the disease will require more than just biomedical interventions. Controlling the outbreak of Mpox will require overcoming many barriers to access to prevention measures and mitigation measures, including disparities in access to these countermeasures, inadequate capacity for surveillance, social stigma, and lack of education and awareness about Mpox. Conclusion: Mpox is now and will continue to be a global health threat, as more countries develop faster ways to respond to outbreaks, coordinate response efforts, and share important information with each other. Lastly, it is essential that MPX does not become endemic.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述使用 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 等数据库进行了全面的文献检索。该审查严格审查了当前有关mpox流行病学、病毒学和公共卫生的知识,评估了传播方法,识别了弱势群体,检查了新菌株,并审查了预防和治疗方法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Mpox 通过动物传播给人类,并通过人与人之间的接触传播,包括密切的身体接触和性接触。高危人群包括儿童、免疫功能低下者和孕妇。Ib 分支菌株的出现构成了严重威胁,特别是在非洲。疫苗(MVA-BN、LC16m8)和替科维马等抗病毒药物可有效控制和预防麻疹,但全球获得这些干预措施的情况各不相同。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了防止mpox流行,必须改善预防措施的获得,加强监测能力,减少社会耻辱,并加强教育和认识。为了有效应对疫情并共享关键信息,全球需要协调一致的努力。

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:Mpox(以前称为猴痘)是由猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起的人畜共患病毒性疾病,猴痘病毒是痘病毒科正痘病毒属的一种有包膜双链 DNA 病毒。该病毒于 1958 年首次被分离出来,但近年来它再次成为全球主要的公共卫生问题,120 多个国家报告了病例。方法:本综述严格审查了目前对 Mpox 的流行病学、病毒学和公共卫生的了解;评估 Mpox 的传播方式;确定人口中的弱势群体;检查新出现的病毒株;并回顾了目前可用于预防和治疗 Mpox 的方法。使用 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Google Scholar 等数据库进行了全面的文献检索。结果:Mpox 通过动物和人与人之间的接触传播给人类,包括密切的身体和性接触。风险最高的群体是儿童、免疫系统受损的人和孕妇。新菌株 Ib 的出现对非洲人民构成了潜在的严重和/或致命威胁,疫苗(MVA-BN、LC16m8)和抗病毒药物(如替科维马)的开发已成功控制和预防 Mpox 疾病,但世界各地获得疫苗和治疗的情况差异很大。讨论:虽然在开发 Mpox 疫苗和抗病毒治疗方面取得了重大进展,但遏制该疾病需要的不仅仅是生物医学干预措施。控制 Mpox 的爆发需要克服获得预防措施和缓解措施的许多障碍,包括获得这些对策的差异、监测能力不足、社会耻辱以及缺乏对 Mpox 的教育和认识。结论:随着越来越多的国家开发出更快的方法来应对疫情、协调应对工作并相互共享重要信息,MPox 现在并将继续成为全球健康威胁。最后,重要的是 MPX 不会流行。

papers.title: Triple IFN pathway deficiency sensitizes mice to human respiratory virus infection independent of human viral receptor expression.
papers.abstract: Interferon (IFN) pathways form the innate barrier against viral invasion and partial deficiency in these pathways allows human virus infection. Whether a complete IFN pathway deficiency could confer the susceptibility to human viral infection independent of expressing the human viral receptor remains unknown. We develop an innate immunity severely deficient mouse model, designated AGL, which features one-step knock-out of the IFNAR, IFNGR and IFNLR. The AGL mice become susceptible to diverse representative human respiratory viruses, including adenovirus type 55 (HAdV-55; double-stranded DNA), human monkeypox virus (MPXV) clade IIb (double-stranded DNA), parainfluenza virus (PIV; negative-sense single-stranded RNA), and the clinically isolated SARS-CoV-2 delta variant (positive-sense single-stranded RNA). Our results suggest that the type III IFN pathway constitutes a backup layer of antiviral frontline beneath the type I and II IFN pathways. In addition, proof-of-concept studies testing MPXV and PIV antivirals highlight the translational value of AGL mice. The AGL mice, as a universal model, substantially enhance the ability to investigate both emerging and established viruses without the need for tailored mouse models.

papers.abstract_zh: 干扰素 (IFN) 通路形成了抵御病毒入侵的先天屏障,这些通路的部分缺陷会导致人类病毒感染。完整的干扰素途径缺陷是否会导致对人类病毒感染的易感性,而与人类病毒受体的表达无关,目前仍不清楚。我们开发了一种先天免疫严重缺陷的小鼠模型,命名为 AGL,其特点是一步敲除 IFNAR、IFNGR 和 IFNLR。AGL小鼠对多种代表性人类呼吸道病毒敏感,包括55型腺病毒(HAdV-55;双链DNA)、人猴痘病毒(MPXV)IIb分支(双链DNA)、副流感病毒(PIV;负义单链RNA)和临床分离的SARS-CoV-2 delta变种(正义单链RNA)。我们的结果表明,III 型干扰素途径构成了 I 型和 II 型干扰素途径下方抗病毒前线的后备层。此外,测试 MPXV 和 PIV 抗病毒药物的概念验证研究强调了 AGL 小鼠的转化价值。AGL 小鼠作为一种通用模型,大大增强了研究新兴病毒和既定病毒的能力,而无需定制小鼠模型。

papers.title: Clinical, Epidemiological, and Demographic Predictors of Laboratory-Confirmed Mpox among Rash-Presenting Patients: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study

Methods: A retrospective cross-sectional analysis was conducted using data from the national Health Electronic Surveillance Network (HESN). papers.abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘 (mpox) 是一种人畜共患病毒性疾病,1958 年首次在猴子中发现,后来于 1970 年在人类中发现。历史上,mpox 在中非和西非流行,2022 年爆发后,它在全球范围内引起了广泛关注,导致在多个国家广泛传播。该疾病通常表现为发烧、疲劳和进行性皮疹,但其临床特征常常与其他皮疹相关病症重叠,使诊断变得复杂。因此,了解人口统计和流行病学预测因素对于支持早期病例识别和公共卫生应对措施至关重要。本研究旨在描述沙特阿拉伯吉达实验室确诊的mpox患者的临床、流行病学和人口统计学特征,并确定出现皮疹的患者中mpox阳性的独立预测因子。方法:使用国家卫生电子监测网络(HESN)的数据进行回顾性横断面分析。2022 年至 2025 年间在吉达政府和私立医院接受过 MPOX PCR 检测的所有出现皮疹的患者均被纳入其中。分析了人口统计学变量和临床症状。使用曼-惠特尼 U 检验和卡方检验进行组间比较。使用多变量逻辑回归来确定mpox阳性的独立预测因素,并使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积(AUC)、敏感性和特异性来评估模型性能。结果:共纳入 443 例患者,其中 147 例(33.2%)mpox 阳性。与 MPOX 阴性患者相比,Mpox 阳性患者的中位年龄显着较高(35 岁 vs. 10 岁)。

papers.title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
papers.abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.

papers.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区医护人员应对猴痘大流行的准备情况:快速回顾调查知识差距
papers.source_body_en: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.

papers.title: Dynamic m6A epitranscriptomic remodeling coordinates host transcriptional reprogramming during MPXV infection.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The global emergence of monkeypox virus (MPXV) highlights the urgent need for a deeper understanding of host-pathogen interactions. Although transcriptional responses to MPXV infection have been characterized, the role of epitranscriptomic regulation particularly N6‐methyladenosine (m6A) modification remains largely unexplored. METHODS: We performed an integrated analysis of time‐series transcriptomic and m6A methylome profiles using whole blood samples collected from MPXV‐infected rhesus macaques at 7, 14, and 21 days post‐infection, with distinct animals used at each time point. Host gene expression and m6A modification dynamics were examined over the course of infection. Differential expression and differential m6A modification analyses were conducted, followed by integrative pathway and immune cell signature profiling. RESULTS: MPXV infection induced sustained host reprogramming, characterized by suppression of immune pathways and activation of metabolic processes. A global increase in m6A modifications was observed, accompanied by upregulation of the methyltransferase METTL3 and downregulation of demethylases (FTO, ALKBH5) and readers (YTHDF1-3). Knockdown of METTL3 or YTHDF2 reduced viral replication, suggesting a proviral role for this regulatory circuit. Integrative analysis identified 38 genes with coordinated changes in both transcription and m6A modification across all three time points. Focusing on literature-curated pathogenic pathways, we further identified 11 dual-regulated host factors. Notably, DNAJB1 was the only gene shared between these two independent selection strategies. m6A peaks near transcription start sites and within 5'UTR positively correlated with gene expression, whereas coding region modifications showed weak negative correlations. Immune lineage signatures showed gradual declines in T cell, NK, and monocyte/macrophage signatures with a progressive increase in B cell signatures. Cross‐dataset comparison confirmed core m6A regulatory trends despite heterogeneity across tissues and viral strains. CONCLUSIONS: This study reveals m6A epitranscriptomic remodeling as a key correlate of the host response to MPXV infection and nominates DNAJB1 alongside the other 10 dual‐regulated genes as candidate host factors for further mechanistic investigation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)在全球的出现凸显了迫切需要更深入地了解宿主与病原体之间的相互作用,尽管对 MPXV 感染的转录反应已经得到表征,但表观转录组调控尤其是 N6-甲基腺苷(m6A)修饰的作用仍然很大程度上未被探索。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用感染后 7、14 和 21 天从感染 MPXV 的恒河猴采集的全血样本,对时间序列转录组和 m6A 甲基化组谱进行了综合分析,每个时间点都使用不同的动物。
elements_zh.methods: 在感染过程中检查宿主基因表达和 m6A 修饰动态,进行差异表达和差异 m6A 修饰分析,然后进行整合途径和免疫细胞特征分析。
elements_zh.main_results: MPXV 感染诱导持续的宿主重编程,其特征是抑制免疫途径和激活代谢过程,并且观察到 m6A 修饰的整体增加,伴随着甲基转移酶 METTL3 的上调和去甲基酶(FTO、ALKBH5)和读者(YTHDF1-3)的下调。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: METTL3 或 YTHDF2 的敲除减少了病毒复制,表明该调节回路具有前病毒作用,综合分析确定了 38 个基因在所有三个时间点的转录和 m6A 修饰方面均发生协调变化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这项研究揭示了 m6A 表观转录组重塑是宿主对 MPXV 感染反应的关键相关因素,并提名 DNAJB1 与其他 10 个双重调节基因一起作为进一步机制研究的候选宿主因素。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管组织和病毒株之间存在异质性,但跨数据集比较证实了核心 m6A 调控趋势,并且该研究仅限于恒河猴的全血样本,这可能无法完全代表人类感染。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘病毒(MPXV)在全球的出现凸显了深入了解宿主与病原体相互作用的迫切需要。尽管对 MPXV 感染的转录反应已经得到表征,但表观转录组调控尤其是 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) 修饰的作用仍然很大程度上未被探索。方法:我们使用感染后 7、14 和 21 天从感染 MPXV 的恒河猴采集的全血样本,对时间序列转录组和 m6A 甲基化谱进行综合分析,每个时间点使用不同的动物。在感染过程中检查宿主基因表达和 m6A 修饰动态。进行差异表达和差异 m6A 修饰分析,然后进行整合途径和免疫细胞特征分析。结果:MPXV 感染诱导持续的宿主重编程,其特征是抑制免疫途径和激活代谢过程。观察到 m6A 修饰的整体增加,伴随着甲基转移酶 METTL3 的上调和去甲基酶(FTO、ALKBH5)和阅读器(YTHDF1-3)的下调。METTL3 或 YTHDF2 的敲低会减少病毒复制,表明该调节回路具有促病毒作用。综合分析确定了 38 个基因在所有三个时间点的转录和 m6A 修饰方面均发生协调变化。以文献报道的致病途径为重点,我们进一步确定了 11 个双重调节的宿主因子。值得注意的是,DNAJB1 是这两种独立选择策略之间唯一共享的基因。m6A 峰位于转录起始位点附近和 5'UTR 内,与基因表达呈正相关,而编码区修饰则表现出弱负相关。免疫谱系特征显示 T 细胞、NK 和单核细胞/巨噬细胞特征逐渐下降,而 B 细胞特征逐渐增加。尽管组织和病毒株之间存在异质性,但跨数据集比较证实了核心 m6A 调控趋势。结论:这项研究揭示了 m6A 表观转录组重塑是宿主对 MPXV 感染反应的关键相关因素,并提名 DNAJB1 与其他 10 个双重调节基因一起作为进一步机制研究的候选宿主因素。

papers.title: Severe Mpox and Uncontrolled HIV Co-Infection in Lagos, Nigeria - A Case Report.
papers.abstract: Mpox, a re-emerging orthopoxvirus infection, shares clinical similarities with smallpox but is typically less severe. However, immunosuppressed individuals, including those with uncontrolled HIV infection, are at risk for severe and atypical clinical presentations of mpox. We report the case of a 40-year-old Nigerian man living with HIV who was non-adherent to antiretroviral therapy (ART) and presented with extensive vesiculopustular eruptions that evolved into vegetative, ulcerated plaques accompanied by fever, lymphadenopathy, and significant weight loss. Laboratory evaluation showed profound immunosuppression (CD4 <20 cells/μL), and polymerase chain reaction (PCR) testing for mpox was positive. He required 14 weeks of inpatient care, including supportive therapy, broad-spectrum antimicrobials, and intensive wound management. Mpox-specific antiviral therapies were unavailable. Although he achieved clinical recovery, he developed post-inflammatory alopecia, dyspigmentation, and significant psychological distress. This case highlights the risk of severe and prolonged mpox in people living with advanced HIV, the importance of early recognition and microbiological confirmation via PCR, and the need for multidisciplinary supportive care, including infection control, wound and skin management, ART optimisation, and mental-health support. Mpox-specific antivirals should also be made more accessible for patients with severe disease.

papers.title: Real-World Safety and Effectiveness of Cabotegravir in People Living with HIV: Interim Report of a Post-marketing Surveillance in Japan.
papers.abstract: Cabotegravir (CAB) is an integrase strand transfer inhibitor and the first long-acting injectable antiretroviral agent for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), administered with rilpivirine. Because approval in Japan relied largely on overseas and international collaborative trials, domestic real-world evidence remains limited. This study evaluated the real-world safety and effectiveness of CAB in people living with HIV (PLHIV) in Japan. This interim analysis (June 27, 2022 and June 17, 2025) was part of an ongoing post-marketing surveillance of Japanese PLHIV treated with CAB at institutions participating in the HIV-related Drugs Cooperative Survey. Safety was assessed by the incidence of adverse drug reactions (ADRs). Associations between ADR incidence and background characteristics were examined using Fisher’s exact and χ2 tests without multiplicity adjustment. Effectiveness was evaluated using virologic suppression assessed by log-transformed HIV RNA copies/mL and peripheral CD4+ cell counts. A total of 121 and 117 participants were included in the safety and efficacy analysis sets, respectively; most were aged over 20 years, and over 96% were male participants. Overall, 76 ADRs were reported in 45 participants (37.19%). The most frequent ADRs were injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each). Four serious ADRs that were not explicitly deemed unrelated to CAB by the reporting physicians occurred in 4 participants: hepatitis B reactivation, monkeypox, syphilis, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Stratification analyses by participant characteristics revealed high ADR incidences among participants aged ≥ 30 to < 40 years (p = 0.038), without allergy (p = 0.016), and with comorbidities (p = 0.045). HIV RNA copies remained suppressed and CD4+ cell counts were maintained at levels comparable to treatment initiation throughout follow-up. This interim analysis indicates that CAB therapy is safe, with no new safety signals, and effective, as demonstrated by sustained virological suppression and stable CD4+ cell counts. These findings are consistent with outcomes reported in overseas and international collaborative clinical studies. Taking multiple oral medications every day can be challenging for people living with human immunodeficiency virus (PLHIV). Cabotegravir, co-administered with rilpivirine, is the first long-acting injectable HIV treatment that can be given once monthly or every 2 months. Its approval in Japan was primarily based on overseas and international collaborative studies, and real-world clinical evidence in Japan has been limited. To address this gap, a post-marketing surveillance has been conducted to confirm the safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir in Japanese PLHIV. This was a 3-year interim analysis of post-marketing surveillance including 121 participants at 10 institutions in Japan who were virologically suppressed for over 6 months before switching to cabotegravir. analysis.research_question_and_background: Cabotegravir (CAB) is the first long-acting injectable antiretroviral for HIV, administered with rilpivirine, but its real-world safety and effectiveness in Japan were insufficiently documented despite approval based largely on overseas trials.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a 3-year interim analysis of a post-marketing surveillance conducted at 10 institutions in Japan between June 27, 2022 and June 17, 2025, enrolling 121 participants who were virologically suppressed for over 6 months before switching to CAB.
analysis.methods: Safety was assessed by the incidence of adverse drug reactions (ADRs) using Fisher’s exact and χ2 tests without multiplicity adjustment, while effectiveness was evaluated by virologic suppression via log-transformed HIV RNA copies/mL and peripheral CD4+ cell counts.
analysis.main_results: Overall, 76 ADRs were reported in 45 participants (37.19%), with injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain each occurring in 12.40%; four serious ADRs occurred in four participants, and HIV RNA remained suppressed with CD4+ counts maintained throughout follow-up.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as confirming no new safety signals and sustained effectiveness of CAB in real-world Japanese settings, consistent with overseas clinical studies, and highlight the novelty of domestic post-marketing surveillance evidence.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results cautiously support the real-world safety and effectiveness of CAB in Japanese PLHIV, addressing a critical evidence gap from prior reliance on overseas trials and informing domestic clinical practice.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s small sample size, lack of multiplicity adjustment, and absence of a control group limit causal inference and generalizability, warranting a moderate strength of evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This interim analysis of a Japanese post-marketing surveillance evaluated the real-world safety and effectiveness of cabotegravir (CAB), the first long-acting injectable HIV treatment, in 121 virologically suppressed participants across 10 institutions from June 2022 to June 2025. Safety was assessed by adverse drug reactions (ADRs), with 76 events reported in 45 participants (37.19%), predominantly injection site pain and musculoskeletal pain (12.40% each), and four serious ADRs occurred. Effectiveness was confirmed by sustained HIV RNA suppression and stable CD4+ counts throughout follow-up. The authors conclude that CAB demonstrated no new safety signals and maintained effectiveness consistent with overseas trials, addressing a domestic evidence gap. However, the small sample size, lack of multiplicity adjustment, and absence of a control group limit the strength of evidence, warranting cautious interpretation.

papers.abstract_zh: Cabotegravir (CAB) 是一种整合酶链转移抑制剂,也是第一种针对人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 的长效注射型抗逆转录病毒药物,与利匹韦林 (rilpivirine) 一起给药。由于日本的批准主要依赖于海外和国际合作试验,因此国内现实世界的证据仍然有限。这项研究评估了 CAB 在日本艾滋病毒感染者 (PLHIV) 中的现实安全性和有效性。这项中期分析(2022 年 6 月 27 日和 2025 年 6 月 17 日)是参与 HIV 相关药物合作调查的机构对接受 CAB 治疗的日本 PLHIV 进行的上市后监测的一部分。通过药物不良反应(ADR)的发生率来评估安全性。使用 Fisher 精确检验和 χ2 检验检查 ADR 发生率与背景特征之间的关联,无需进行多重性调整。使用通过对数转换的 HIV RNA 拷贝数/mL 和外周 CD4+ 细胞计数评估的病毒学抑制来评估有效性。安全性和有效性分析组分别包括 121 名和 117 名参与者;大多数年龄在20岁以上,其中超过96%是男性参与者。总体而言,45 名参与者 (37.19%) 报告了 76 起 ADR。最常见的不良反应是注射部位疼痛和肌肉骨骼疼痛(各 12.40%)。报告医生未明确认为与 CAB 无关的四种严重 ADR 发生在 4 名参与者身上:乙型肝炎再激活、猴痘、梅毒和 2 型糖尿病。按参与者特征进行的分层分析显示,年龄 ≥ 30 岁至 < 40 岁(p = 0.038)、无过敏(p = 0.016)和有合并症(p = 0.045)的参与者中 ADR 发生率较高。在整个随访过程中,HIV RNA 拷贝仍然受到抑制,CD4+ 细胞计数也维持在与治疗开始时相当的水平。这项中期分析表明,CAB 疗法是安全的,没有新的安全信号,而且是有效的,持续的病毒学抑制和稳定的 CD4+ 细胞计数证明了这一点。这些发现与海外和国际合作临床研究报告的结果一致。对于人类免疫缺陷病毒 (PLHIV) 感染者来说,每天服用多种口服药物可能具有挑战性。卡博特韦 (Cabotegravir) 与利匹韦林 (rilpivirine) 联合给药,是第一种长效注射 HIV 治疗药物,可每月或每 2 个月注射一次。它在日本的批准主要基于海外和国际合作研究,日本的真实临床证据有限。为了弥补这一差距,我们进行了上市后监测,以确认卡博特韦对日本艾滋病毒感染者的安全性和有效性。这是一项为期 3 年的上市后监测分析,包括日本 10 家机构的 121 名参与者,这些参与者在改用卡博特韦之前已被病毒学抑制了 6 个多月。在随访期间,45名参与者经历了76种药物不良反应(37.19%),包括注射部位疼痛和肌肉骨骼疼痛(各12.40%)、口腔疱疹、高胆固醇、注射部位增厚或硬化、发烧和白细胞计数减少(各2.48%)。这些发现与之前的临床研究报告一致。年龄≥30岁至<40岁、无过敏以及患有其他疾病的参与者中观察到较高的药物不良反应发生率。大多数与卡博特韦相关的药物不良反应发生在治疗开始后 180 天内。在整个随访期间,HIV RNA 拷贝仍然受到抑制,CD4+ 细胞计数维持在与治疗开始时相似的水平。总体而言,这些结果证实了卡博特韦在日本的现实安全性和有效性。

papers.title: Perceived employment vulnerability in Latin America in the context of a potential new pandemic: a multicountry cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Emerging infectious disease threats may reactivate concerns about employment instability and economic disruption, particularly in regions marked by labor informality, social inequality, and limited social protection. Although the effects of COVID-19 on employment have been widely documented, less is known about how workers perceive the potential labor consequences of future health emergencies. This study aimed to assess perceived labor-related repercussions of a potential new pandemic among workers in Latin America. METHODS: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from an online survey administered to workers from more than ten Latin American countries between June and July 2022, during the early phase of the 2022 mpox outbreak. Participants were asked about the expected impact of a potential new pandemic on their employment, salary, and overall work situation. Associations between perceived labor-related repercussions and sociodemographic and occupational factors were evaluated using Poisson generalized linear models with a log link and robust variance, adjusted for country of residence. RESULTS: Among 850 surveyed workers, 64.2% perceived that a potential new pandemic would have a considerable or very strong impact on their work. In the adjusted analysis, men reported a lower perceived impact than women (aPR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.78-0.97; p = 0.009). Lower perceived impact was also observed among those engaged in virtual work (aPR: 0.64; 95% CI: 0.44-0.93; p = 0.018) and hybrid work (aPR: 0.84; 95% CI: 0.73-0.97; p = 0.017), compared with in-person workers. No occupational sector showed a statistically significant difference compared with healthcare workers in the revised adjusted model, although the food sector had a higher, non-significant point estimate. CONCLUSIONS: Perceived labor-related vulnerability in the context of a potential new pandemic was substantial among workers in Latin America. Perceptions differed mainly according to sex and work modality, while occupational-sector estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of subgroup heterogeneity and limited precision.

The study concludes that perceived labor-related vulnerability is substantial in the region, highlighting the need for preparedness strategies that address gender and work-modality disparities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 新出现的传染病威胁可能会重新引发人们对就业不稳定和经济混乱的担忧,特别是在劳动力非正规、社会不平等和社会保护有限的地区。尽管 COVID-19 对就业的影响已被广泛记录,但人们如何看待未来突发卫生事件对劳动力的潜在影响却知之甚少。这项研究旨在评估拉丁美洲工人中潜在的新流行病对劳工相关的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项分析性横断面研究是利用 2022 年 6 月至 7 月期间(即 2022 年 MPOX 爆发的早期阶段)对来自 10 多个拉丁美洲国家的工人进行的在线调查的二手数据进行的。参与者被问及潜在的新流行病对其就业、工资和整体工作状况的预期影响。
elements_zh.methods: 使用具有对数链接和稳健方差的泊松广义线性模型评估了感知到的与劳动力相关的影响与社会人口和职业因素之间的关联,并根据居住国进行了调整。
elements_zh.main_results: 在850名接受调查的工人中,64.2%的人认为潜在的新冠疫情会对他们的工作产生相当大或非常强烈的影响。在调整后的分析中,男性报告的感知影响低于女性(aPR:0.87;95% CI:0.78-0.97;p = 0.009)。与现场工作人员相比,从事虚拟工作(aPR:0.64;95% CI:0.44-0.93;p = 0.018)和混合工作(aPR:0.84;95% CI:0.73-0.97;p = 0.017)的人的感知影响也较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在潜在的新流行病背景下,拉丁美洲的工人认为与劳工相关的脆弱性很大。看法的差异主要取决于性别和工作方式,而由于亚组异质性和有限的精度,职业部门的估计值应谨慎解释。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,拉丁美洲未来的大流行防范战略必须解决性别和工作方式差异,以有效减轻预期的经济和就业干扰。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Emerging infectious disease threats may reactivate concerns about employment instability and economic disruption, particularly in regions marked by labor informality, social inequality, and limited social protection. Although the effects of COVID-19 on employment have been widely documented, less is known about how workers perceive the potential labor consequences of future health emergencies. This study aimed to assess perceived labor-related repercussions of a potential new pandemic among workers in Latin America.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from an online survey administered to workers from more than ten Latin American countries between June and July 2022, during the early phase of the 2022 mpox outbreak. Participants were asked about the expected impact of a potential new pandemic on their employment, salary, and overall work situation.
analysis_en.methods: Associations between perceived labor-related repercussions and sociodemographic and occupational factors were evaluated using Poisson generalized linear models with a log link and robust variance, adjusted for country of residence.
analysis_en.main_results: Among 850 surveyed workers, 64.2% perceived that a potential new pandemic would have a considerable or very strong impact on their work. In the adjusted analysis, men reported a lower perceived impact than women (aPR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.78-0.97; p = 0.009). Lower perceived impact was also observed among those engaged in virtual work (aPR: 0.64; 95% CI: 0.44-0.93; p = 0.018) and hybrid work (aPR: 0.84; 95% CI: 0.73-0.97; p = 0.017), compared with in-person workers.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Perceived labor-related vulnerability in the context of a potential new pandemic was substantial among workers in Latin America. Perceptions differed mainly according to sex and work modality, while occupational-sector estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of subgroup heterogeneity and limited precision.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that future pandemic preparedness strategies in Latin America must address gender and work-modality disparities to effectively mitigate anticipated economic and employment disruptions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which precludes causal inference, and by the reliance on self-reported perceptions. papers.title_zh: 在潜在的新流行病背景下拉丁美洲的就业脆弱性:多国横断面研究。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Emerging infectious disease threats may reactivate concerns about employment instability and economic disruption, particularly in regions marked by labor informality, social inequality, and limited social protection. Although the effects of COVID-19 on employment have been widely documented, less is known about how workers perceive the potential labor consequences of future health emergencies. This study aimed to assess perceived labor-related repercussions of a potential new pandemic among workers in Latin America. METHODS: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from an online survey administered to workers from more than ten Latin American countries between June and July 2022, during the early phase of the 2022 mpox outbreak. Participants were asked about the expected impact of a potential new pandemic on their employment, salary, and overall work situation. Associations between perceived labor-related repercussions and sociodemographic and occupational factors were evaluated using Poisson generalized linear models with a log link and robust variance, adjusted for country of residence. RESULTS: Among 850 surveyed workers, 64.2% perceived that a potential new pandemic would have a considerable or very strong impact on their work. In the adjusted analysis, men reported a lower perceived impact than women (aPR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.78-0.97; p = 0.009). Lower perceived impact was also observed among those engaged in virtual work (aPR: 0.64; 95% CI: 0.44-0.93; p = 0.018) and hybrid work (aPR: 0.84; 95% CI: 0.73-0.97; p = 0.017), compared with in-person workers. No occupational sector showed a statistically significant difference compared with healthcare workers in the revised adjusted model, although the food sector had a higher, non-significant point estimate. CONCLUSIONS: Perceived labor-related vulnerability in the context of a potential new pandemic was substantial among workers in Latin America. Perceptions differed mainly according to sex and work modality, while occupational-sector estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of subgroup heterogeneity and limited precision.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:新出现的传染病威胁可能会重新引发人们对就业不稳定和经济混乱的担忧,特别是在劳动力非正规、社会不平等和社会保护有限的地区。尽管 COVID-19 对就业的影响已被广泛记录,但人们如何看待未来突发卫生事件对劳动力的潜在影响却知之甚少。这项研究旨在评估拉丁美洲工人中潜在的新流行病对劳工相关的影响。方法:利用 2022 年 6 月至 7 月(2022 年 MPOX 爆发早期阶段)对来自 10 多个拉丁美洲国家的工人进行的在线调查的二手数据进行了一项分析性横断面研究。参与者被问及潜在的新流行病对其就业、工资和整体工作状况的预期影响。使用具有对数链接和稳健方差的泊松广义线性模型评估了感知到的与劳动力相关的影响与社会人口和职业因素之间的关联,并根据居住国进行了调整。结果:在 850 名接受调查的工人中,64.2% 的人认为潜在的新流行病将对他们的工作产生相当大或非常强烈的影响。在调整后的分析中,男性报告的感知影响低于女性(aPR:0.87;95% CI:0.78-0.97;p = 0.009)。与现场工作人员相比,从事虚拟工作(aPR:0.64;95% CI:0.44-0.93;p = 0.018)和混合工作(aPR:0.84;95% CI:0.73-0.97;p = 0.017)的人的感知影响也较低。在修订后的调整模型中,与医护人员相比,没有职业部门显示出统计上的显着差异,尽管食品部门的点估计值较高,但不显着。结论:在潜在的新流行病背景下,拉丁美洲工人感知到的与劳工相关的脆弱性很大。看法的差异主要取决于性别和工作方式,而由于亚组异质性和有限的精度,职业部门的估计值应谨慎解释。

papers.title: South Africa’s next viral emergence may already be here: under-recognized zoonotic and arboviral transmission as a surveillance blind spot
papers.abstract: South Africa has demonstrated exceptional capacity for viral detection and genomic analysis, most visibly through severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) genomics and wastewater-based monitoring. Yet outside respiratory virus programmes, the country’s approach to emerging viral infections remains comparatively reactive, pathogen-specific, and biased toward high-visibility events. This Perspective argues that South Africa’s most actionable surveillance blind spot is not only the importation of novel pathogens, but the delayed recognition of transmission already underway within endemic and re-emerging zoonotic and arboviral systems. Using illustrative exemplars-mpox, Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, Rift Valley fever virus, and neglected neuroinvasive arboviruses- we propose that “emergence” in South Africa often takes the form of under-diagnosed local amplification rather than dramatic first appearance. We advocate a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy coupled to an integrated One Health “signal-to-action” framework that links clinical syndromes with veterinary events, vector and environmental monitoring, and proportionate laboratory escalation (targeted molecular/serology testing, confirmatory assays, and sequencing when indicated). The objective is not indiscriminate multiplexing, but earlier alignment between ecological risk, clinical suspicion, and test availability- so that outbreak response begins despite tentative early signals and before widespread human infection or the acceleration of the outbreak.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines under-recognized zoonotic and arboviral transmission in South Africa as a surveillance blind spot, focusing on pathogen detection, local amplification, and the gap between ecological risk and clinical suspicion within endemic systems (A3, A4). The central question addresses how current surveillance approaches fail to identify transmission already underway in these systems rather than novel importations (A3).
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative Perspective advocating a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy integrated with a One Health framework, emphasizing earlier alignment between ecological risk, clinical suspicion, and test availability (A5, A6). It critiques South Africa’s reactive, pathogen-specific surveillance outside respiratory virus programmes (A2). The supplied evidence does not report databases, search dates, eligibility criteria, selection methods, or included-study counts.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: South Africa has demonstrated strong capacity for viral detection and genomic analysis, particularly in SARS-CoV-2 surveillance (A1). The review concludes that the most actionable surveillance blind spot is delayed recognition of local amplification in zoonotic and arboviral systems, exemplified by mpox, Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, Rift Valley fever virus, and neglected neuroinvasive arboviruses (A3, A4).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights a reactive and pathogen-specific surveillance approach outside respiratory virus programmes, which may miss under-diagnosed local amplification events (A2). It argues that current systems are biased toward high-visibility events, leaving endemic and re-emerging zoonotic and arboviral systems under-monitored (A2, A4). The supplied evidence does not report specific conflicting findings or unresolved mechanisms.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review prioritizes implementing a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy linked to an integrated One Health framework to enable earlier outbreak response despite tentative early signals (A5, A6). It emphasizes proportionate laboratory escalation, including targeted molecular/serology testing, confirmatory assays, and sequencing when indicated, to align ecological risk with clinical suspicion and test availability (A5).

analysis.summary_en: This Perspective critiques South Africa’s reactive and pathogen-specific surveillance for emerging viral infections, highlighting a critical blind spot in recognizing under-diagnosed local amplification within endemic zoonotic and arboviral systems. While the country excels in viral detection and genomic analysis, particularly for SARS-CoV-2, its approach often misses transmission already underway, exemplified by mpox, Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, Rift Valley fever virus, and neglected neuroinvasive arboviruses. The authors advocate for a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy integrated with a One Health framework to align ecological risk, clinical suspicion, and test availability, enabling earlier and proportionate outbreak response despite tentative early signals.

papers.title_zh: 南非的下一个病毒出现可能已经在这里:作为监测盲点的人畜共患和虫媒病毒传播未被充分认识
papers.source_body_en: South Africa has demonstrated exceptional capacity for viral detection and genomic analysis, most visibly through severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) genomics and wastewater-based monitoring. Yet outside respiratory virus programmes, the country’s approach to emerging viral infections remains comparatively reactive, pathogen-specific, and biased toward high-visibility events. This Perspective argues that South Africa’s most actionable surveillance blind spot is not only the importation of novel pathogens, but the delayed recognition of transmission already underway within endemic and re-emerging zoonotic and arboviral systems. Using illustrative exemplars-mpox, Crimean–Congo haemorrhagic fever virus, Rift Valley fever virus, and neglected neuroinvasive arboviruses- we propose that “emergence” in South Africa often takes the form of under-diagnosed local amplification rather than dramatic first appearance. We advocate a syndrome-based, diagnostically guided strategy coupled to an integrated One Health “signal-to-action” framework that links clinical syndromes with veterinary events, vector and environmental monitoring, and proportionate laboratory escalation (targeted molecular/serology testing, confirmatory assays, and sequencing when indicated). The objective is not indiscriminate multiplexing, but earlier alignment between ecological risk, clinical suspicion, and test availability- so that outbreak response begins despite tentative early signals and before widespread human infection or the acceleration of the outbreak.
papers.abstract_zh: 南非在病毒检测和基因组分析方面表现出了卓越的能力,最明显的是通过严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 基因组学和废水监测。然而,在呼吸道病毒计划之外,该国应对新出现的病毒感染的方法仍然相对反应性、病原体特异性,并且偏向于高可见度事件。本观点认为,南非最可行的监测盲点不仅是新型病原体的输入,而且是对地方性和重新出现的人畜共患病和虫媒病毒系统中已经发生的传播的延迟认识。通过使用典型的例子——mpox、克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒、裂谷热病毒和被忽视的神经侵袭性虫媒病毒——我们提出,南非的“出现”通常采取诊断不足的局部放大形式,而不是戏剧性的首次出现。我们提倡一种基于综合征的诊断指导策略,与综合的 One Health“信号到行动”框架相结合,将临床综合征与兽医事件、病媒和环境监测以及按比例的实验室升级(有针对性的分子/血清学检测、验证性检测和有指示时的测序)联系起来。目标不是不加区别地进行多重检测,而是更早地协调生态风险、临床怀疑和检测可用性,以便在出现初步的早期信号且在人类广泛感染或疫情加速爆发之前就开始应对疫情。

papers.title: SemVac: A Semantic Vaccinology Paradigm Powered by LLMs for Antigen Discovery
papers.abstract: Reverse vaccinology has enabled sequence-based antigen discovery, but it overlooks the rich semantic knowledge embedded in the biomedical literature. Here we establish Semantic Vaccinology (SemVac), a paradigm that leverages large language models (LLMs) to predict protective antigens directly from scientific text. Benchmarking 14 state-of-the-art LLMs on a curated antigen dataset shows that text-reasoning-based approaches match or exceed specialized deep learning models in precision, while offering superior robustness on functionally ambiguous proteins. Intriguingly, explicit reasoning modes (e.g., chain-of-thought) increase recall but consistently reduce precision, revealing an over-reasoning pitfall in biological discovery tasks. Applied to the complete proteome of Mpox virus, SemVac recapitulates known protective antigens and identifies previously unrecognized candidates such as B20R, which our semantic analysis links to immune evasion and structural exposure. This work establishes literature-driven semantic reasoning as a powerful complement to conventional vaccinology, with broad implications for AI-aided scientific discovery.

papers.abstract_zh: 反向疫苗学使得基于序列的抗原发现成为可能,但它忽视了生物医学文献中蕴含的丰富语义知识。在这里,我们建立了语义疫苗学 (SemVac),这是一种利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 直接从科学文本预测保护性抗原的范例。在精心策划的抗原数据集上对 14 个最先进的法学硕士进行基准测试表明,基于文本推理的方法在精度上匹配或超过了专门的深度学习模型,同时对功能模糊的蛋白质提供了卓越的鲁棒性。有趣的是,显式推理模式(例如思维链)会增加召回率,但会持续降低精度,揭示了生物发现任务中的过度推理陷阱。SemVac 应用于 Mpox 病毒的完整蛋白质组,可重现已知的保护性抗原,并识别以前未识别的候选抗原,例如 B20R,我们的语义分析将其与免疫逃避和结构暴露联系起来。这项工作将文献驱动的语义推理作为传统疫苗学的有力补充,对人工智能辅助的科学发现具有广泛的影响。

Adds StockTitan as a preferred source · opens Google Add on Google Not now 07/15/2026 - 01:05 PM Data show clade IIb from 2022 outbreak is 100 to 100,000-fold less virulent than clade IIa from 2003 outbreak Three new models for investigating mpox infection and pathogenesis identified Tonix is advancing TNX-801, a live, attenuated, minimally replicative investigational vaccine candidate based on horsepox virus to protect against mpox disease BERKELEY HEIGHTS, N.J., July 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. (Nasdaq: TNXP) (“Tonix” or the “Company”), a fully integrated, commercial-stage biotechnology company, today announced the publication of a paper, "Monkeypox virus clade IIb isolate exhibits reduced virulence relative to clade IIa isolates in multiple murine models," in the Journal of Virology, the peer-reviewed publication of the American Society for Microbiology (ASM). The research, conducted at Tonix, found new animal models for investigating mpox pathogenesis and demonstrated significant differences in virulence between the clade IIb circulating in the U.S. and the historic 2003 clade IIa. The manuscript can be accessed at: https://doi.org/10.1128/jvi.00247-26. “Global mpox outbreaks that have caused severe human disease continue to occur due to previously unrecognized subclades,” said Seth Lederman, M.D., Chief Executive Officer of Tonix Pharmaceuticals. “New approaches to understand and mitigate the spread of emerging mpox subclades are urgently needed. To examine the pathogenesis of emerging mpox clades, we identified three new murine models susceptible to mpox clade II infection, which revealed significant differences in virulence between clades. As Tonix investigates TNX-801 (live attenuated horsepox vaccine) for the prevention of mpox and smallpox, establishing additional foundational models are important to categorize and ultimately protect against the disease." “The decreased virulence of clade IIb may have contributed to its ability to spread worldwide,” said Sina Bavari, Ph.D., Executive Vice President of Tonix and site head of Tonix’s Research and Development Center (RDC) in Frederick, Maryland. “Indolent subclinical infection is a risk factor for unintentional spread. Importantly, a deeper understanding of mpox virus (MPXV) pathogenesis will help guide the continued development and positioning of the TNX-801 vaccine platform, a vaccine candidate against mpox. Tonix is committed to advancing the understanding of emerging mpox disease and to developing TNX-801 platform as a potential vaccine candidate to address the continuing global threat posed by mpox.” Led by Farooq Nasar, Ph.D., Director, Virology, Tonix utilized its state-of-the-art research laboratory capabilities, including a Biosafety Level 3 (BSL-3) lab and an Animal Biosafety Level 3 (ABSL-3) facility, at RDC which is close to the center of the U.S. biodefense research community. Mpox is an emerging human disease caused by four distinct MPXV subclades (Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb). Despite their genetic similarities, the case fatality rates differ considerably among the subclades: Ia (~11%), Ib and IIa (~4%), and IIb (~0.2%). Since 2022, multiple mpox outbreaks caused by the previously unrecognized Ib and IIb subclades have led the World Health Organization to declare two Public Health Emergencies of International Concern. Cases are currently increasing in multiple regions of the Americas. This unprecedented global spread and the marked differences in disease severity among MPXV subclades underscore the importance of investigating the pathogenesis of emerging MPXV variants. However, a critical limitation has been the lack of suitable small animal models. This publication expands on the previously established CAST/EiJ mouse model by evaluating susceptibility to MPXV subclade IIa and IIb infection in both 7- to 8-week-old and 4- to 5-month-old mice. The demonstrated susceptibility of older CAST/EiJ mice to clade IIa infection highlights the utility of this model for evaluating long-term vaccine durability and protective efficacy. In addition, the study describes three novel C57BL/6 mouse models deficient in the interferon-α receptor, interferon-γ receptor, or both receptors for the study of MPXV infection. The study demonstrates that the emerging clade IIb isolate is up to 100,000-fold less virulent than clade IIa isolates. Collectively, these models provide valuable new tools for rapidly investigating the pathogenesis of emerging MPXV subclades and evaluating medical countermeasures, including vaccines. About Mpox Mpox is an acute contagious disease caused by the monkeypox virus or MPXV, which is also a member of the orthopoxvirus family. Mpox is emerging as an important zoonotic infection in humans in Central and West Africa. Until 2022, only a few cases of mpox were reported outside of Africa in patients who had been infected while in Africa. Starting in May of 2022, mpox clade II cases spread rapidly in the U.S. and other countries. The World Health Organization (WHO) declared mpox clade IIb to be a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). The clade II mpox affects mostly men who have sex with men in the U.S., where it has become endemic. The WHO lifted PHEIC designation for clade Ib. In August 2024, the WHO declared mpox clade Ib to be a PHEIC due to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo that spread globally, including to the U.S. clade Ib affects children and adults. Although the WHO has lifted PHEIC designation for clade Ib, mpox continues to spread in Africa, and mutations of the virus are considered by public health experts to be an ongoing threat to be monitored for new epidemic spread. About TNX-801 TNX-801 (recombinant horsepox virus) is an attenuated, minimally replicative, live virus vaccine based on horsepox in pre-clinical development to prevent mpox and smallpox. TNX-801 is expected to enter a Phase 1 study in 2027 pending FDA clearance of an Investigational New Drug Application (IND). TNX-801 is in the pre-IND stages of development. Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. Tonix Pharmaceuticals* is a fully integrated, commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on central nervous system (CNS) disorders, infectious diseases, immunology conditions, and rare diseases where there exists high unmet medical need. TONMYA® (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets 2.8mg), the Company’s flagship internally conceived and developed medicine, is the first new treatment for fibromyalgia in more than 15 years. Tonix’s CNS commercial infrastructure supports its marketed products, including its acute migraine products, Zembrace® SymTouch® (sumatriptan injection 3 mg) and Tosymra® (sumatriptan nasal spray 10 mg). Tonix is extending the science behind TONMYA in Phase 2 clinical studies to evaluate the potential of TNX-102 SL in major depressive disorder and acute stress disorder/acute stress reaction. Tonix is also advancing a pipeline of infectious disease programs, including monoclonal antibody TNX-4800 (anti-OspA mAb) for Lyme disease prevention in the U.S. and TNX-801 (horsepox, live virus vaccine), a vaccine in development for the prevention of mpox and smallpox. Tonix has been awarded a contract with the U.S. DoD’s Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) for up to $34 million over five years to develop TNX-4200, small molecule broad-spectrum antiviral agents targeting CD45 for the prevention or treatment of infections to improve the medical readiness of military personnel in biological threat environments. Tonix owns and operates a state-of-the art infectious disease research facility in Frederick, Maryland. Within immunology, Tonix is developing TNX-1500 (anti-CD40L mAb), a third-generation CD40 ligand inhibitor for the prevention of kidney transplant rejection. Finally, the Company’s rare disease portfolio includes TNX-2900, which is Phase 2 ready for the treatment of Prader-Willi syndrome. news.title_zh: Tonix Paper 推出三种用于 Mpox 疫苗研究的新小鼠模型 - Stock Titan
news.source_body_en: On July 15, 2026, Tonix Pharmaceuticals announced the publication of a peer-reviewed study in the Journal of Virology detailing new murine models for mpox research. The research, conducted at Tonix, identified three new mouse models—including CAST/EiJ and C57BL/6 strains—to investigate mpox pathogenesis. The study found that the 2022 outbreak clade IIb mpox virus is approximately 100 to 100,000-fold less virulent than the historic 2003 clade IIa in these models, with reported case fatality rates of 11% for clade IIa and 0.2% for clade IIb. These models support the assessment of medical countermeasures, including the investigational vaccine candidate TNX-801. The paper addresses a critical gap in suitable small animal models for mpox research and was accompanied by a positive market reaction, with Tonix stock gaining 4.97% on the publication date.

“畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接Research Article Open access 猴痘病毒(Monkeypox virus,MPXV)是人类猴痘(mpox)疾病的病原体。该病毒包含两个分支(clade),即中非clade I和西非clade II,其病死率分别约为11%和约4%。自1970年发现猴痘疾病以来,该病毒一直局限于非洲。然而在2022年,此前未被识别的 subclade IIb 引发了规模最大的全球猴痘疫情,病死率约为0.2%。MPXV 各 subclade 在人类感染中毒力的差异值得进一步研究,但一个关键限制是缺乏易感小动物模型。在本研究中,研究人员调查了四种小鼠模型(包括CAST-EiJ和三种免疫缺陷模型:C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?、C57BL/6 Ifngr?/?和C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?/Ifngr?/?)对MPXV clade IIa(WR 7-61和US-2003)和clade IIb(MA-2022)分离株的易感性。所有四种小鼠模型均对clade IIa感染易感,导致以体温下降、体重减轻和致死为特征的严重疾病。相比之下,在相同剂量下,clade IIb感染在所有四种小鼠模型中仅产生轻微至轻度疾病。仅在最高剂量(8.0 log10PFU)下,clade IIb分离株在最易感的免疫缺陷小鼠模型C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?/Ifngr?/?中产生了严重疾病(40%致死率)。这是在小鼠模型中首次证实clade IIb引起致死性疾病。此外,数据显示clade IIa的毒力比clade IIb高约100至100,000倍,并为研究MPXV感染和发病机制提供了三个额外的小鼠模型。研究背景方面,猴痘病毒(Monkeypox virus,MPXV)属于痘病毒科(Poxviridae)正痘病毒属(Orthopoxvirus),其基因组为长约197至200千碱基对(kilobase pairs,kbp)的线性双链DNA,编码约190种蛋白质。猴痘是一种人畜共患病,在部分中非和西非地区呈地方性流行,天然宿主可能包括松鼠、巨袋鼠、非洲睡鼠和非人灵长类动物(non-human primates,NHPs)。MPXV根据系统发育、地理分布和人类疾病严重程度分为两个主要分支(clade):中非clade I(刚果盆地)和西非clade II,人类病死率分别约为11%和约4%。自1970年在扎伊尔(现刚果民主共和国)报告首例人类病例后的五十年间,零星暴发主要局限于非洲。然而2022年由先前未识别的subclade IIb引发的全球大流行波及122个国家约10万例确诊病例,病死率约0.2%,且96%的感染者为男男性行为者(men who have sex with men,MSM),首次记录了性传播途径。随后clade Ib也引发多起暴发,使得MPXV现包含四个subclade:Ia、Ib、IIa和IIb,人类病死率分别为约11%(Ia)、约4%(Ib和IIa)和约0.2%(IIb)。不同clade间毒力差异显著,但目前缺乏合适的小动物模型是研究MPXV新兴subclade发病机制的关键障碍。既往仅有哺乳期小白鼠、SCID-BALB/c、C57BL/6 stat1?/?和CAST/EiJ四种小鼠被证实对MPXV易感,且多数研究使用clade I分离株,比较clade IIa与IIb致病性的文献甚少。因此,研究人员旨在评估clade IIa与IIb在多种小鼠模型中的毒力差异,并拓展可用的小鼠模型。该研究发表于《Journal of Virology》。义翘神州StemVive人肺泡类器官扩增培养基预定中,欢迎了解详细信息>>领 取 为开展研究,研究人员采用的主要关键技术方法包括:从GenBank下载MPXV代表序列进行最大似然法(maximum likelihood)系统发育树构建以确认分离株进化关系;对病毒挑战株进行全基因组下一代测序(Next-Generation Sequencing,NGS)分析基因变异;在Vero和BSC-40细胞中进行空斑表型分析及多步生长动力学测定以评估体外复制特性;建立四种小鼠模型(CAST/EiJ、C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?、C57BL/6 Ifngr?/?、C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?/Ifngr?/?),经鼻内(intranasal,IN)、阴道内(intravaginal,IV)和直肠内(intrarectal,IR)途径感染MPXV clade IIa(WR 7-61、US-2003)和clade IIb(MA-2022)分离株,样本来源于BEI Resources;每日监测疾病评分、体温、体重减轻和生存率14天;使用非参数单因素方差分析(ANOVA)、Mann-Whitney t检验及对数秩检验等进行统计分析。 研究结果部分如下: In silico和in vitro表征clade II挑战株:研究人员通过系统发育分析确认WR 7-61和Sierra Leone属clade IIa,MA-2022属clade IIb且与新加坡和英国分离株相近。基因分析显示各clade间存在基因缺失、截短及长度多态性差异,如OPG016、OPG017、OPG005仅截短存在于clade IIa,而OPG032仅截短存在于clade Ia等。体外实验中,三株病毒在Vero和BSC-40细胞4天感染后产生约1至3毫米空斑,WR 7-61和US-2003表型均匀,MA-2022呈混合表型;多步生长动力学显示三者在BSC-40细胞中24小时滴度增加约10,000倍,72小时达峰值约8.0 log10PFU/mL,复制动力相似。 7至8周龄CAST/EiJ小鼠经鼻内途径感染MPXV clade IIa(WR 7-61)与IIb(MA-2022)分离株的毒力差异:WR 7-61感染呈剂量依赖性致严重疾病,7.0 log10PFU组所有小鼠7天内达安死标准,5.0和4.0 log10PFU组分别有83%和33%死亡,伴随体温下降约-13°F至-11°F、体重减轻约-20%至-13%。而7.0 log10PFU的MA-2022感染仅致最低疾病评分约0.5,无显著体温体重变化,全部存活。 4至5月龄CAST/EiJ小鼠经鼻内途径感染MPXV clade IIa(WR 7-61)与IIb(MA-2022)分离株的毒力差异:6.0 log10PFU WR 7-61组50%小鼠9天内死亡,体重减轻约-20%;4.0 log10PFU组全部存活。MA-2022(7.0 log10PFU)仅致轻微疾病评分约0.8,无致死,全部存活。 C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?小鼠经鼻内途径感染MPXV IIa(WR 7-61、US-2003)与IIb(MA-2022)分离株的毒力差异:WR 7-61和US-2003在5.0至7.0 log10PFU剂量下致快速疾病进展,所有高剂量组5至8天内全部死亡,低剂量US-2003(5.0 log10PFU)有60%死亡,伴体温降约-14°F至-10°F、体重减约-20%至-24%。MA-2022在6.0至7.0 log10PFU未致重症,仅高剂量有约-9%体重减轻,全部存活。 C57BL/6 Ifngr?/?小鼠经鼻内途径感染MPXV IIa(WR 7-61、US-2003)与IIb(MA-2022)分离株的毒力差异:WR 7-61和US-2003高剂量(7.0、6.0 log10PFU)组5至8天内全部死亡,低剂量(5.0 log10PFU)全部存活但伴体重减轻约-19%至-28%。MA-2022两剂量组仅致轻度疾病,体温微降约-4°F,体重减约-9%至-16%,全部存活。 C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?/Ifngr?/?小鼠经鼻内途径感染MPXV clade IIa(WR 7-61、US-2003)与IIb(MA-2022)分离株的毒力差异:WR 7-61和US-2003在4.0至6.0 log10PFU下致重症,高剂量组4天内全部死亡,低剂量组70%至90%死亡。MA-2022在5.0至6.0 log10PFU无重症,仅高剂量有约-8%体重减,全部存活。后续在高剂量8.0 log10PFU MA-2022感染下,40%小鼠5至6天内死亡,伴体温降约-5°F、体重减约-15%,首次在小鼠模型证实IIb致死性。 C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?小鼠经阴道内和直肠内途径对MPXV clade IIa(WR 7-61)与IIb(MA-2022)分离株的易感性:WR 7-61经阴道内7.0 log10PFU致80%小鼠感染部位红肿(评分约1),各剂量有约-3%至-6%体重减,全部存活;直肠内途径无显著红肿但体重减约-2%至-4%,全部存活。MA-2022两途径均无显著疾病,微体重减,全部存活。 C57BL/6 Ifnar?/?/Ifngr?/?小鼠经阴道内和直肠内途径对MPXV clade IIa(WR 7-61)与IIb(MA-2022)分离株的易感性:WR 7-61阴道内高剂量致红肿及评分约1,体重减约-9%,全部存活;直肠内途径红肿率20%至100%,评分约0.3至1.2,体重减约-7%至-8%,全部存活。MA-2022两途径均无显著疾病,微体重减,全部存活。
